title: Illusion Magic
description: If you aren't a Wizard, you can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from the **Illusion** (substance: sight and/or sounds; verbs: cloak; disguise) School of Magic. At the start of each session you get Aether equal to your int. For more details, see the Wizard Starting Move, **Weave the Arcane**.

outcomes.text: If you're a Wizard, add the following verbs to your repertoire:

submoves.description: Once per Scene, when someone believes in one of your illusions, clear a Condition.

title: Alter Perception
description: When you **touch someone or something**, spend 1 Aether to alter one of their perceptible aspects. For example, you can make it seem like they're from a different ancestry, or that an item is magical when it really isn't (and vice versa). This effect lasts until you dismiss it or until the end of the Scene.

title: Mirror Image
description: When you **would suffer damage**, you may spend 1 Aether to reveal that you were an illusion and prevent all dmg; say where **near** you actually are.

title: Color Spray
description: When you **spray an array of flashing, colored light from your hands**, spend 1 Aether and roll+dex.

outcomes.text: A group of **close** NPCs are dazed for a while. You and your allies get **adv** on their next roll against them.
They're dazed only for a moment.
The magic is countered or backfires; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Near-Death Experience
description: When you or an ally would kill an NPC, spend 1 Aether to have the killing blow exist only as an illusion. They feel all the pain and trauma, but it wasn't real. They're alive and shaken to their core; the would-be killer gets **adv** to **Pull Strings** on them by threatening their safety or interests.
